name: Isle Royale National Park
policyReason: Only service dogs are allowed on Isle Royale; no pets, even on boats in park waters.
summary: Only service dogs are allowed on Isle Royale; no pets, even on boats in park waters.

excerpts.quote: Only service dogs are allowed on Isle Royale.

dogRules.text: No pets on boats within park waters, 4.5 miles out into Lake Superior.
Service dogs need a permit before the trip.
Leashed pets allowed outdoors at the Houghton Visitor Center.
